title: Frozen sequential protected quantum Reader head on a fresh 256-question cohort
hypothesis: A frozen sequentially protected quantum Reader head retains more answer-supporting passages in Top5 than the frozen Reader and matched classical head on identity-disjoint natural questions.
mechanism: The fitted head applies question-conditioned candidate score corrections after the frozen DPR Reader while sequential protection constraints preserve accepted members; inference receives no semantic review labels.

rating_policy.notes: The project deliberately keeps this bounded screen at L0 until a complete real-data formal evaluation and independent confirmation are finished.

training_budget.data_scope: Frozen upstream train59 sequential checkpoint; no training or tuning on the fresh 256-question cohort.
training_budget.epochs_or_steps: No new optimization; one immutable Reader/quantum/classical inference pass.
training_budget.selection_rule: Deterministic identity-disjoint 256-question cohort frozen before scoring; semantic review restricted to the 67 changed-set union.
training_budget.seed_policy: Frozen head/checkpoint seeds; blind packet and 10000-resample bootstrap seed 2026101906.

intervention.target: Fixed Top50 to Top5 passage membership after the frozen DPR Reader.

data_scope.task_family: Natural Questions open-domain RAG passage selection with fixed Wiki-DPR Top50

statistics.method: Paired question-cluster percentile bootstrap over all 256 questions; unchanged questions contribute exact zero deltas; statistic is sum of useful plus direct points.

controls.notes: Exact original Reader Top5 on the same frozen candidates.
Frozen matched classical head evaluated in the same immutable score pass and blind review.

task_utility.notes: Prospective semantic evidence-retention gates passed against both Reader and matched classical control, but the project's primary utility contract requires complete full-data evaluation.

robustness.notes: Paired bootstrap lower bounds are positive, but there is only one 256-question cohort and no independent full-data confirmation.

natural_transfer.notes: The cohort is natural NQ/Wiki-DPR data, but transfer beyond this fixed source and split is not tested.

attention_alignment.notes: Method-blind semantic review directly measures whether selected passages support the question; it does not measure Generator use.

classical_attribution.notes: The frozen quantum head exceeds the preregistered matched classical head on this screen with a positive paired bootstrap lower bound; finite-shot and resource attribution remain separate unmet axes.

finite_shot.notes: No finite-shot or noisy quantum execution was performed.

resource_audit.notes: State preparation, gate, query, measurement, readout and runtime accounting are not complete.

trace_observability.selection_rule: All 67 questions where any frozen Top5 set differed; all 404 passages in the three-arm Top5 union; no outcome-based case selection.
trace_observability.notes: Training is outside this frozen inference screen; the previously fitted checkpoint is immutable.

l2_full_real_data.formal_evaluation_population: A complete preregistered untouched natural-data population remains to be frozen.
l2_full_real_data.selection_guard: No post-score resampling, replacement, threshold change, or label-conditioned selection.
l2_full_real_data.data_exposure_policy: Exclude all training, validation87, historical100, and current256 identities from fresh confirmation units; semantic labels open only after frozen transport.

next_upgrade.action: Preregister the complete untouched natural-data replication population and two independent confirmation units; do not execute the formal run yet.
next_upgrade.success_gate: Positive predeclared useful and points deltas versus Reader in the complete population and both independent confirmations, with paired uncertainty excluding zero; matched-classical comparison reported separately.
next_upgrade.kill_criteria: Stop this frozen head if the complete formal population or either required independent confirmation fails its frozen utility gate, or if any identity/leakage/provenance contract is violated.
next_upgrade.estimated_cost: Design is CPU-only and low cost; later execution requires one full Reader score pass plus method-blind review of every changed-set union.

limitations: The 256-question screen is not the complete formal evaluation population.
Only one fresh split and frozen checkpoint were tested; no independent full-data confirmation exists.
Semantic evidence retention is not Generator answer accuracy.
Finite-shot quantum execution and resource accounting were not performed.
The project preregistration caps this result at L0 despite satisfying the generic ingredients of a held-out positive intervention screen.
paper_angles: A protected quantum Reader scoring head can improve evidence retention over Reader and a matched classical head, pending full-data replication and strict attribution.

records.role: prospective blind review and utility gate
